newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-BELGIUM BEAT TURKEY 3-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIUM BEAT TURKEY 3-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Belgium beat Turkey 3-1 (halftime 3-1) in their World Cup European group seven qualifier on Wednesday.

Turkey - 1-Rustu Recber, 2-Recep Cetin, 3-Bulent Korkmaz, 4-Tolunay Kafkas, 5-Hakan Unsal (16-Celil Sagir 45), 6-Arif Erdem (18-Tayfun Havutcu 45), 7-Tayfun Korkut, 8-Ogun Temizkanoglu, 9-Hakan Sukur, 10-Tugay Kerimoglu (15-Hami Mandirali 75), 11-Oktay Derelioglu.

Belgium - 1-Filip De Wilde, 2-Bertrand Crasson, 3-Albert De Roover, 4-Eric Van Meir, 5-Rudy Smidts (Oliver Doll 58), 6-Franky Van der Elst, 7-Lorenzo Staelens, 8-Luis Olivera, 9-Emile Lokonda Mpenza, 10-Vincenzo Scifo, 11-Nico Van Kerckhoven.
